content.text: [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/setting-up-nowpayments-webhooks-cloudflare-workers-everything-you-17|setting]] up a sovereign digital store is a four-step sequence that most creators overcomplicate by starting in the wrong order. Step one is the backend: Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handles payment verification, order logging, and product delivery. Step two is the payment layer: NOWPayments connects your wallet addresses to the checkout flow — no KYC required from you or your buyer. Step three is the storefront: Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages serves your store for free with no server management. Step four is testing: [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-4|COREMERCH guide to complete]] a real mainnet transaction, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Only after step four passes cleanly should you promote the store. COREMERCH deploys the complete Edge Stack — Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/supabase-order-database-digital-stores-everything-you-need-22|Supabase as]] plus NOWPayments — in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The key to overcoming platform restrictions lies in leveraging open, decentralized technologies. By using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, creators can build a sovereign digital commerce stack. This stack, combined with NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment verification, empowers creators to sell digital products globally, regardless of their location or platform restrictions.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital store, it's essential to have a clear understanding of your product offerings, target audience, and the technical requirements for your store. You'll need to decide on the specific tools and services that best fit your needs, such as choosing between GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages for hosting, and selecting the appropriate backend logic and order storage solutions. Additionally, you'll need to set up a NOWPayments account to facilitate crypto payments.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up your payment and delivery pipeline involves integrating NOWPayments with your chosen backend logic and order storage solutions. This integration enables automatic crypto payment verification and instant product delivery. With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, with a low fee of 0.5% per transaction, and without the need for KYC or buyer accounts. By leveraging recommended networks like BSC, Solana, or TRON, you can keep transaction fees under $0.10.

Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your store is set up and your payment and delivery pipeline is configured, you're ready to go live and start processing transactions. It's crucial to test your store thoroughly, ensuring that all components are working as expected, from product display to payment processing and delivery. With Stack 01, you can deploy your store in as little as 4-6 hours following the Sovereign Blueprint, while Stack 02, deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours, offers an end-to-end tested solution with 30-day support.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your store gains traction, you'll need to scale your infrastructure to meet growing demand. This involves monitoring your store's performance, identifying bottlenecks, and optimizing your backend logic and order storage solutions as needed. By leveraging the scalability of Cloudflare Pages and Supabase, you can ensure that your store remains performant and reliable, even under high traffic conditions. Additionally, the Sovereign Blueprint provides a scaling playbook to help you navigate the process of expanding your store's capacity.
